+from fastapi import FastAPI, Query
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from typing import List, Optional, Union
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+@app.get("/optional-list-new")
+async def read_optional_list_new(q: list[int] | None = Query(None)):
+    return {"q": q}
+
+@app.get("/complex-union")
+async def read_complex_union(q: list[int] | str | None = Query(None)):
+    return {"q": q}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_optional_list_new():
+    # No query param
+    response = client.get("/optional-list-new")
+    assert response.json() == {"q": None}
+    # With query param
+    response = client.get("/optional-list-new", params={"q": [1, 2]})
+    assert response.json() == {"q": [1, 2]}
+
+def test_complex_union():
+    # No query param
+    response = client.get("/complex-union")
+    print(f"Complex union None: {response.json()}")
+    assert response.json() == {"q": None}
+    # With string
+    response = client.get("/complex-union", params={"q": "hello"})
+    print(f"Complex union string: {response.json()}")
+    assert response.json() == {"q": "hello"}
+    # With list
+    response = client.get("/complex-union", params={"q": [1, 2]})
+    print(f"Complex union list: {response.json()}")
+    assert response.json() == {"q": [1, 2]}
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_optional_list_new()
+        print("test_optional_list_new passed")
+        test_complex_union()
+        print("test_complex_union passed")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
+        exit(1)
